annotations.title: Search VI Update, Good Day and The Straight Record

description: Keyword search across published VI Update articles, Good Day, This Week editions and The Straight Record editions, or one of them. Use for finding coverage of a person, place, agency or event. Each result has an id for fetch, a title, a URL with a story anchor where there is one, a snippet, a match tier (exact phrase, all words, some words) with the reason, and its own citeAs line. Results are ranked by tier, then by whether the headline carries the match; across all three publications they take turns within a tier. Paging uses offset and next_offset. Facts are as of each item's date.

offset.description: How many ranked results to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

query.description: Words or a phrase, such as "WAPA rationing" or "Strait of Hormuz".

section.description: Limit to one publication: "vi_update", "good_day" or "straight_record". Default: all three.

name: search
